address: Basement 1 level, 228 Tianhe Road, Tianhe, Guangzhou, China Mainland
bio: The romantic and dimly lit dining space is done out in European style, but Lingnan motifs and old-time Guanxi scenes are featured for an eclectic effect. Popular items on the menu include beef tenderloin Wellington with a red wine sauce and the black truffle risotto with pan-seared foie gras. The monthly changing tasting menu keeps things fresh for regulars....
